test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 48, 12 and 24 days, respectively. Working together, they will complete the work in _____ days.
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 48 days.

B can complete the work in 12 days.

C can complete the work in 24 days.

**Formula used:**

Work done in one day = 1/Days to complete work

**Calculation:**

Work done by A in one day = 1/48

Work done
